title: SeaWindow: Tide Times, Charts and Coastal Weather
description: View tides, coastal weather, sun and moon times on iPhone. Learn SeaWindow’s data sources and download the app for your coast.
facts: SeaWindow shows tide predictions, coastal weather, sun and moon times on iPhone with iOS 18 or later. Today’s view and one favorite coast are free; Pro adds a ten-day outlook and additional tools. Data coverage varies; modeled water levels are labelled estimates. It is a planning aid, not a navigation or safety tool.

guides.title: How to Read a Tide Chart: Highs, Lows and Datum
guides.headline: How to read a tide chart
guides.description: Read a tide chart in minutes: time, height, highs and lows, and the datum behind each number, with a worked NOAA example and the steps in SeaWindow.
guides.summary: A tide chart is a curve of predicted water height over time: peaks are high tides, dips are low tides, and every height is measured from a datum (MLLW at NOAA stations in the US). Worked example: NOAA station 9414290, San Francisco (Golden Gate), 5 November 2026: low 0.9 ft at 1:47 AM, high 5.9 ft at 8:35 AM, low 0.7 ft at 2:48 PM, high 4.7 ft at 9:03 PM (MLLW); mean sea level is 3.12 ft above MLLW there. In SeaWindow the Today tab’s Tides card shows the water level now, Rising or Falling, the next high and low, the station, its distance, the provider and, under “Tide table & source”, the datum. Predictions exclude weather; SeaWindow is a planning aid, not a navigation or safety tool.
